proposed_fixes.title: Always On Top border can remain on the wrong virtual desktop
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Border visibility may be refreshed on focus changes but not every virtual-desktop visibility transition, allowing a border window to outlive the pinned window on another desktop.
plan: Trace border visibility on virtual-desktop switch and direct taskbar activation with the All desktops taskbar option.
Synchronize border hide/show with window desktop visibility transitions rather than relying solely on focus changes.
Add a regression test for switching directly between pinned and unpinned windows on separate desktops.
verification: Switch desktops by clicking taskbar windows and verify the border follows only the pinned window across repeated transitions.
